_comment: Regenerated 2026-09-15 for GATE2LHSdt.glb. Root cause found: the raw scan's local axes are NOT gravity-aligned -- it needs roughly +80deg rotation about X to sit upright (confirmed via glb.ee viewer's import correction, and verified here: after that rotation, top-down raycasting yields one single connected, smoothly-varying surface across 1637 of 1732 hit cells, height range only ~3.6 units end to end). Previous heightmap files for this and the other model treated raw glTF Y as up, which is why they looked catastrophically warped -- they were being sliced through sideways, not from above. walkthrough.js now applies the same +80deg model.rotation.x correction on load so the visual mesh and this heightmap's coordinate space agree. heights/walkable cover the whole scanned corridor (nearest-neighbor filled where the raycast had no direct hit); spawn is near one end of the coherent surface, facing into the corridor.
